protocol.acceptance: all six metrics pass on fixed jet validation and an additional independent scalar-AD point set; finite values required
protocol.stop_check: before training, every 100 Adam updates, then after each block of at most 20 L-BFGS iterations
protocol.cache_policy: mandatory preflight populates dependency/compiler caches; each solve gets new parameters, optimizer state and CUDA graphs; setup is reported and included in total
protocol.timing: optimization wall includes loss/gradient, optimizer, line searches, synchronization, all stop checks and final independent acceptance; per-run setup and common data preparation are separately reported and included in total

problem.relationship_to_openai_ns_formal: independent manufactured steady NS boundary-value problem
problem.coordinates: physical x,y, no nonlinear coordinate transform
problem.boundary_condition: Dirichlet u,v on every edge; exact p at x=1 fixes pressure gauge

gemm_planning.layout: contiguous row-major storage; output alignment 256 bytes
gemm_planning.concurrency: serialized calls; cross-stream ordering required; one workspace per plan
gemm_planning.persistence: process-local only; never reload algorithms on another environment
gemm_planning.selection: 7 paired rounds, graph of 16 identical GEMMs per timing; Torch wins within 2 percent
gemm_planning.scope: finite heuristic pool plus Torch, not global optimum; repeats reuse identical matrices
gemm_planning.torch_workspace_accounting: internal workspace not exposed by this API
